description: GENERAL goal-derivation (jabberwock's design): the agent DERIVES ITS OWN GOALS by assuming+confirming the non-salient and spending every goal on the single most-SALIENT yet-unexplained perceived region. salience = (not-ground)*colour-rarity, read over attrs the eye already sets. assume_confirm_boring silences ground/filler; gap_role_unknown opens an open Implication only on a salient unknown; select_frontier promotes the loudest to frontier_pick, which the autonomy seed's mint_goal_from_frontier turns into a wanted understand-goal. §1 only (frontier+goal); experiment(§2)/resolve(§3) follow. Nothing names a game. | §0 CONFIRMED MOTION: directional ActionKinds carry known displacement (Up Δ−1,0 / Down +1,0 / Left 0,−1 / Right 0,+1 / Select point-effect), general grid-control fact. §2 PURSUE: the active goal's target -> the known move (Argmax distance-reduction, a JOIN) -> chosen_action. The derived goal now MOVES the avatar toward the salient cell. | §3 RESOLVE/RE-AIM: goal_reached (avatar within manhattan<=1 of the target -> contacted + snapshot score) then resolve_role (fold the consequence into target.role = rewarding if score rose else inert; shut the gap open=0; satisfy the goal -> satisfy_goal drops the want -> Drive re-aims at the next salient unknown). A 'wrong' salient pick self-corrects: reach, learn inert, move on. | unpick_resolved: a resolved gap (open!=1) drops its frontier_pick so mint_goal_from_frontier can't re-mint the satisfied goal — lets the Drive re-aim. | §4 META-COGNITIVE (additive): a gap's role-guess carries a Beta(α=1+confirms,β=1+refutes) CI (ci_width=2Z√var, ~0.58 at n=0, contracts ~1/√n); fold_contact books one confirm/refute per contact (score rose vs baseline?); ORDER-N risk=stake/(stake+stake_half), stake=actions_since_reset (≈0 early/reset-free, →1 late/replay-expensive); tol(risk)=ci_tol_base/(1+k·risk) loose early tight late; commit_role folds the role (Beta mean) ONLY when ci_width≤tol(risk) else insufficient_information re-arms a probe. Same evidence commits early, insufficient late. | §4b DELIBERATION BUDGET: probe_price=c_probe/max(action_budget,1) (the action-meter as COST), probe_value=ci_width·(risk+eps); probe again only if value>price, else commit on current-best — a scarce budget raises the price and forces commitment. No clock.
